'''Mardecin''' is a small town in [[Amadicia]].

==History==
There is a garrison of the [[Children of the Light]] in the town.

==Recent events==
Mardecin has fallen on hard times as many of the shops are closed. When [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Thomdril Merrilin]] and [[Juilin Sandar]] are traveling through Amadicia, they stop and camp outside of Mardecin.{{ref/book|5|8}} Nynaeve and Elayne walk into Mardecin to buy supplies. Once in the town, Nynaeve recognizes an emergency signal of the [[Yellow Ajah]] outside a dressmaker's shop. Upon entering [[Ronde Macura]]'s shop, Nynaeve gives the proper phrases to hear the message. Ronde Macura, however, was under orders to find and capture Elayne. Ronde doses both women with [[forkroot]] tea, blocking them from ''[[saidar]]'', and ties them up.{{ref/book|5|9}} Luckily, Thom and Juilin rescue the women and the four buy a coach and leave Mardecin.{{ref/book|5|10}}
